Garden City Walks

Discover Bangalore’s greener side through guided nature walks, led by Radha and Suchi. Let us introduce you to the Garden City, through slow, unhurried walks in its prettiest streets.

Come to hear stories about trees and birds. And through that green lens, also discover Bangalore’s history, culture and lore.

About us

Your guides

Radha Rangarajan & Suchi Govindarajan

We’re old friends, brought together by a shared love of trees and wildlife, books and Bangalore! We are firm believers in the supremacy of filter coffee and masala puri.

After years of working, writing and travelling together, we decided to join forces and tell the city’s stories in the language we know best: that of nature.

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

How long is each walk?

Each walk is 2 hours long and covers 1 to 2 km, at a slow, unhurried pace.

How many people are on a walk?

Our walks are for small groups of up to 20 people.

Can I bring my child along?
  • Yes, we usually charge 50% of the walk price for children aged 10 to 15
  • Children below 10 can attend for free
  • All children should be accompanied by a paying adult throughout the walk duration
Can I bring my child in a pram or stroller?

We’re sorry, but we’d rather you did not. Bangalore’s roads and pavements can be uneven, broken or crowded in places, and that’s sadly out of our control. We wouldn’t want you struggling with a pram while trying to enjoy the walk.

Can I book a walk privately for my group?

Yes. Every walk on our list can be booked privately for families, groups of friends, corporate teams, visiting groups and more. Our tree walks can be done anywhere in the city.

Which areas do your walks cover?

We do our walks all over the city. That's the best thing about trees—they have branches everywhere. If you live in a green street or neighbourhood, let us know and we'll plan a walk for you!

Where do we meet?

We'll send you the details when you book.

What should I wear or bring?
  • Closed walking shoes
  • Sunscreen
  • A bottle of water
  • A hat
  • Long trousers if you have allergies
  • Any medication you need
  • An umbrella if it looks rainy
  • A curious mind!
What happens if it rains?

In Bangalore, rain is usually light or intermittent in the mornings. It doesn't usually stop us from walking. If there is a storm forecast, we will take a call on the day and let you know.

What if I need to cancel?

We're unable to offer refunds, but if you let us know by email at least 24 hours before the walk begins, you can join another upcoming walk within six months. See our Terms & Conditions for details.

Can I transfer my booking to someone else?

Yes, just email us at least 24 hours before the walk begins and copy in the person taking your place, so we can make the change and know who to expect on the day.

Can I bring my pet?

We'd love to meet your pets, but we're afraid they can't join us on our walks.
